profile.summary: A for-profit mechanical construction contractor based in Arnold, California. It does plumbing, heating and air conditioning, and boiler work, and has worked on public projects such as school boiler replacements and a federal dock replacement.

review.notes: Arnold, CA mechanical contractor (plumbing/HVAC/boilers, NAICS 238220) matches the agenda's name, city and boiler-replacement scope; address and phone confirmed on BBB and myMotherLode, legal name/location/federal dock award on GovConInBox, and the school boiler work is corroborated by an SFUSD boiler replacement contract with the same firm. Summary is neutral and supported.
